County withheld inspection reports for two years

The county health department declined for more than two years to release restaurant inspection reports, according to documents reviewed by Example News, citing staffing shortages and an ongoing software migration.

Example News obtained the reports through a FOIA request filed in early 2024, after the department stopped publishing inspection results on its website without explanation or public notice.

Under the state public records act, agencies must respond to requests within ten business days, though they may extend that deadline when records require extensive review or redaction.

A department spokesperson said the backlog had since been cleared and that the online database would return next month, with results going back to the start of the migration.
